tasks.corrected_reference_answer: Static legends create a Line2D handle per category (geopandas/plotting.py:910-946); interactive legends append an HTML list item per category (geopandas/explore.py:890-902). Whether legend work dominates geometry rendering and the exact runtime scaling require measurement.

checked_claims.claim: Pandas comparison protocol forces Python loops
checked_claims.reason: Implementation chooses scalar operator comprehension; code does not imply protocol forbids vectorized implementation.

material_errors: Unsupported necessity of Python loops and incorrect statement that both operands first convert to object arrays.
tasks.notes: Read the question/reference and relevant pinned-source code; static review only, no repository code executed.
tasks.corrected_reference_answer: GeometryArray._binop broadcasts scalar right operands, defers pandas containers with NotImplemented, checks lengths and applies the operator pairwise using a Python comprehension (geopandas/array.py:1662-1687). Spatial methods instead call vectorized Shapely through _binary_method (688-699). This is the implementation split in this revision; it does not establish that pandas requires Python loops or prohibits equivalent vectorization. Equality operators must preserve their scalar equality semantics, which differ from topological predicates.

tasks.notes: Read the question/reference and relevant pinned-source code; static review only, no repository code executed.
tasks.corrected_reference_answer: _read_file opens detected URLs with urllib.request.urlopen(filename), then checks response.headers.get("Accept-Ranges") == "bytes" (geopandas/io/file.py:282-291). If not, it reads the response into memory and sets from_bytes=True; otherwise the original URL is retained for the selected engine. This revision does not send a bytes=0-1 probe or catch connection exceptions as a fallback.

tasks.corrected_reference_answer: The Arrow conversion separates geometry columns and calls table_attr.to_pandas() without conversion keyword arguments (geopandas/io/arrow.py:526-527), then reconstructs geometry columns. Nongeometry dtype conversion therefore follows PyArrow defaults in this pinned implementation. This code does not forward types_mapper or integer_object_nulls to to_pandas, so those cannot be assumed to work as GeoPandas read_parquet options.

tasks.corrected_reference_answer: _explore eagerly obtains a FeatureCollection through the filtered frame’s __geo_interface__, loops over feature properties to escape template braces, and passes the result with styling, tooltip and popup callbacks to folium.GeoJson (geopandas/explore.py:647-669). Larger feature/property payloads and repeated layers increase preparation and map content. These are plausible costs, but the source does not measure high CPU usage or prove which stage dominates; it does not call GeoDataFrame.to_json here.
